reviewer.method: Condition-masked review by experiment author; post-hoc real-source diagnostic; no independent expert validation

reviews.notes: Recognizes p/PP and correctly attributes PP to Sumi Jo, but supplies unsupported interpretation/performance differences as an explanation. General notation uncertainty in the expert source does not establish the cause of this discrepancy.

Treats the expert’s general warning about popular-music notation as the definite cause of the p/PP disagreement. Neither source establishes that causal explanation; partial credit for the quiet opening advice.

Invents balance/volume adjustment as the cause of different written source descriptions and cites Sumi Jo for that unsupported claim. Correct opening advice does not answer whether the cause can be established.

Clearly distinguishes Sumi Jo PP and the other source p, but then invents interpretation/performer-expression differences to explain the discrepancy. The recorded sources do not support that explanation.
